study type: Descriptive study with a retrospective cohort comparison
cohort: The study included all singleton liveborn infants registered in the Faroese Birth Registry from 2010 to 2019 (n = 6121).
finding: The mean birthweight and the proportion of infants with high birthweight significantly increased in the Faroe Islands from 2010 to 2019, and these metrics, along with gestational age at birth, were higher in Faroese infants compared to other Nordic countries.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight increased from 3652 g to 3745 g; thresholds for high birthweight were ≥4000 g and ≥4500 g.
gest_age: Focus on gestational weeks 40-42, and proportion of infants born in gestational week 41 or later (31.5%).
